info.title: WPVLHC AOG Christmas Gala API
info.description: Node.js 24 + Express 5 + Joi + Firestore. Public invitation flows and authenticated church administration. All timestamps are UTC ISO 8601 strings. All non-health responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store. No direct client Firestore access.

post.description: Atomic update. Repeat submissions replace choices, never add quantities. No client name, church or token in the body. 60 attempts per invitation per 15 minutes. Existing inactive items may be kept or reduced but cannot be increased. Each food item ID is a single-person slot. A competing claim returns 409 FOOD_ITEM_TAKEN. Removing the item or declining releases it; the owner may revise quantities.
